note: The mapping for Mizzey's product sheet (Mizzey-Product-Sheet.csv, or the workbook downloaded from Google Sheets or Excel, every tab with the same columns), the one initial migration (MIG-04). Any column named option_<name> fills the attribute <name>, and option_<name>_ar gives its Arabic: on a variation row the value, on the product's row the option's name. category_ar and brand_ar are optional: a sheet without them still reads. Bump the version when the sheet's columns change. See specs/051 and specs/053.

option_.note: One column per option, named by the client: option_size, option_colour, option_capacity, option_scent; option_size_ar beside it for the Arabic
